aged 86, 64 years a member; individual bronze, Surrey County C.C. Championships 1926; pictured

1901-1991; died Christmas Day 1991 aged 90; joined Belgrave 5 July 1923 (68 years' membership); won Michelin Sports mile 1923; Club mile champion 1924; 6th Surrey County XC 1924 (team silver); 3rd Surrey XC at Epsom 2 Jan 1926 (team gold per text 'following year'); 103rd Southern Championships 1925; won 1925 Club 1 mile championship (Garnet Cup) at Battersea Park in 4:41.2; later moved to Fords at Dagenham (1927) and Stoke; donated the Club Honours boards in the 1960s

Our picture shows four of the club's elder statesmen in a relaxed mood during this year's Centenary Club '20' road race. ... They are (left to right) :- Ken O'Kell (86) - 64 years a member, Bill Webb (93) - 60 years a member, Frank Webb (84) - 59 years a member, Norman Dewberry (85) - 59 years a member
Above: Surrey Cross-Country Championships at Epsom, 2nd January 1926. Left to right. Ken O'Kell (Belgrave) 3rd man home, W.T.Dear (Surrey A.C.) 1st, and M.A.Kempton (Ranelagh) 2nd.
Below: 28th February 1925 and the Southern Championships at Beaconsfield. Ken, wearing no. 29, chases his captain Bert. Footer, no. 26. They finished 103rd and 23rd respectively on this occasion.

Above: The 1925 Club Championships at Battersea Park. The final of the 1 mile championship for the Garnet Cup. Left to right: H.E.Footer, K.O'Kell, A.D.Pyer, G.J.Rees, W.D.Pritchard and F.L.Buckingham. The winner was Ken, in 4:41.2, from Buckingham and Footer. Just look at the crowds!
